Name: Holiday Treats by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
Hey, Hi, Howdy and Hello ho ho ho ho

Tis the season for holiday celebrations but you don't have any treats to warm you up on a cold cold Winter Star day? Wickedy's got you! I've added two treats for the holidays for you to add some cheery joy to your game. These are featured in my Gifting Game video collab for Toys for Tots. Two treats are included, as well as a recipe for each.

[u][b][size=3]Holiday Hot Cocoa[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]Buffs: Luck 3, Max Stamina 50 lasts for 3:30[/size]
[*][size=2]Recipe: 1 milk, 1 sugar, 1 chocolate cake[/size]
[/list]
[u][b][size=3]Candy Cane[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]Buffs: Speed 3, Magnet Radius 5 lasts for 3:30[/size]
[*][size=2]Recipe: 5 sugar, 1 cherry, 1 tea leaves[/size]
[/list][size=2]
Both recipes are known by default.[/size]
